# Techsara

> Techsara Solutions is a Frisco, Texas based AI development, IT staffing, and cloud consulting company for US enterprises. It builds and deploys production AI systems - generative AI/LLMs, AI agents, computer vision, NLP, predictive ML, document AI, speech AI, recommendations, and MLOps - in the cloud, on-premise, or at the edge, and provides senior AI, ML, cloud, data, and software engineering talent to enterprise teams across the United States and Canada.

Canonical site: https://www.techsarasolutions.com/
Last updated: 2026-06-13

Techsara serves regulated, high-stakes industries including healthcare, finance, defense, retail, manufacturing, logistics, SaaS, and cloud platforms. Engagement models include direct-hire talent placement, managed delivery teams, and end-to-end project delivery. Contact: hello@techsarasolutions.com, +1 (323) 596-1938.

## Staffing & Engagement Models

- [Talent Solutions](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/services/talent): Direct placement of senior AI, ML, and software engineers with US enterprises
- [Team Solutions](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/services/team): Managed, dedicated engineering teams that integrate with in-house staff
- [Project Solutions](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/services/project): Fixed-scope, end-to-end delivery of AI and software projects
- [International Talent Solutions](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/services/international): Global talent sourcing with US-compliant onboarding
- [All services](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/services): Overview of Techsara staffing and delivery models

## AI & Technology Solutions

- [Generative AI & LLM Development](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/generative-ai): Custom LLM applications, RAG systems, and fine-tuning for enterprises
- [AI Agents & Automation](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/ai-agents): Autonomous agent systems and workflow automation
- [Computer Vision](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/computer-vision): Image and video analysis, detection, and inspection systems
- [NLP & Language Understanding](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/nlp): Text analytics, classification, and language pipelines
- [Predictive Analytics & ML Models](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/predictive-ml): Forecasting, risk, and decision models
- [Chatbots & Assistants](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/chatbots): Conversational AI for support and operations
- [Document AI & OCR](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/document-ai): Intelligent document processing and extraction
- [Speech AI](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/speech-ai): Speech recognition, synthesis, and voice interfaces
- [Recommendations](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/recommendations): Personalization and recommendation engines
- [MLOps & Deployment](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/mlops): CI/CD for ML, monitoring, and production model operations
- [Cloud Deployment](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/cloud-deployment): AWS, Azure, and GCP AI infrastructure (Bedrock, Vertex AI, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI)
- [On-Premise & Local Server AI](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/on-premise): Air-gapped AI on customer hardware for data-sovereign workloads (HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001)
- [Hybrid Cloud & Edge AI](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/hybrid-edge): Train in cloud, infer at edge; federated learning and distillation
- [AI Strategy & Readiness](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/ai-strategy): Roadmaps, governance, and readiness assessments
- [Cloud Architecture & Cost Engineering](https://www.techsarasolutions.com/solutions/cloud-consulting): Cloud architecture review and cost optimization

## Frequently Asked Questions

- What does Techsara do? Techsara is a Frisco, Texas based AI development, IT staffing, and cloud consulting company for US enterprises. It builds generative AI, LLM, computer vision, NLP, predictive ML, document AI, speech AI, recommendation, and MLOps systems, and supplies senior engineering talent.
- Where is Techsara based? Frisco, Texas, serving enterprise teams across the United States and Canada.
- Which industries does Techsara serve? Regulated, high-stakes industries including healthcare, finance, defense, retail, manufacturing, logistics, SaaS, and cloud platforms, with deployment options designed to meet HIPAA, SOC 2, and ISO 27001 requirements.
- Does Techsara offer on-premise or air-gapped AI? Yes - Techsara deploys AI in the cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), on-premise, air-gapped, and hybrid edge environments so regulated enterprises can keep sensitive data on their own hardware.
- What AI technologies and platforms does Techsara use? Generative AI, RAG, fine-tuning, AI agents, computer vision, NLP, and MLOps, deployed on AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Amazon SageMaker, and Azure OpenAI.
- How can companies work with Techsara? Hire direct talent, form a dedicated delivery team, or commission fixed-scope AI and software projects.
